tasks.title: Remove 'ОПЛАТИТЬ' Button from Navigation
tasks.description: Remove the payment CTA button from the navigation bar.
tasks.details: Locate the .nav-btn element in index.html that triggers the #pm-modal and remove it from the navigation section. Ensure the payment modal functionality remains accessible from tour pages.
tasks.testStrategy: Verify the absence of the payment button in the navigation bar and ensure the payment modal is accessible from tour pages.

tasks.title: Simplify Navigation Bar
tasks.description: Reduce the number of elements in the navigation bar for simplicity.
tasks.details: Update the navigation bar to include only: Туры, Блог, О гиде, Отзывы, phone number, 'Выбрать тур' CTA, and RU/EN toggle. Remove duplicate and unnecessary elements.
tasks.testStrategy: Check that the navigation bar contains only the specified elements and functions correctly.

tasks.title: Replace Blue CTAs with Green
tasks.description: Change all blue call-to-action buttons to green.
tasks.details: Find all instances of the color #1A56DB in the CSS and HTML files and replace them with #2d6a4f. Update hover states and gradients accordingly.
tasks.testStrategy: Ensure all CTAs are green and hover states are consistent with the new color scheme.

tasks.title: Add Mobile Sticky Bottom Bar
tasks.description: Implement a sticky bottom bar for mobile viewports.
tasks.details: Create a fixed bar at the bottom of the mobile viewport with two buttons: 'Выбрать тур' (green) and 'WhatsApp' (white/outline). Ensure it is hidden on desktop and has a z-index above content but below modals.
tasks.testStrategy: Test the visibility and functionality of the sticky bar on mobile devices and ensure it is hidden on desktop.

tasks.title: Add Trust Strip Below Hero Section
tasks.description: Introduce a trust strip with key statistics below the hero section.
tasks.details: Add a horizontal row with 4 stat blocks: [500+ туристов] [4.9★ Google] [До 6 человек] [С 2014]. Use a light background (#f8f9fa) with padding of 24px and center the content.
tasks.testStrategy: Verify the presence and correct display of the trust strip below the hero section.

tasks.title: Update Hero Subheadline
tasks.description: Modify the hero section subheadline text and add a badge.
tasks.details: Remove GEL prices from the subheadline and update the text to 'Казбеги от $49 · Тбилиси от $38 · Группы до 6 человек'. Add an 'AUTHENTIC GEORGIA' badge above the H1 in small caps with a green pill background.
tasks.testStrategy: Ensure the updated subheadline and badge are displayed correctly in the hero section.

tasks.title: Update Hero CTA Buttons
tasks.description: Redesign the hero section CTA buttons for consistency.
tasks.details: Change the primary button to have a green background (#2d6a4f) with the text 'Выбрать тур →'. The secondary button should have an outline style with a WhatsApp icon and the text 'Написать Тимуру'. Both buttons should have a border-radius of 8px.
tasks.testStrategy: Check the appearance and functionality of the hero section CTA buttons.

tasks.title: Show Price on Tour Cards
tasks.description: Ensure the price is visible on tour cards without interaction.
tasks.details: Display the price in a large font at the bottom of each tour card, with the format '$49' and smaller text below for '₾128 / 4500₽'.
tasks.testStrategy: Verify that the price is visible on all tour cards without needing to hover.

tasks.title: Add Duration Badge to Tour Cards
tasks.description: Include a duration badge on each tour card.
tasks.details: Overlay a small pill badge with a semi-transparent dark background at the top-left of each card image, displaying the duration (e.g., '12 часов' or '1 день').
tasks.testStrategy: Ensure the duration badge is correctly displayed on all tour cards.

tasks.title: Add Popularity Badges to Tour Cards
tasks.description: Add 'ХИТ' and 'НОВИНКА' badges to popular and new tours.
tasks.details: Place a 'ХИТ' badge on Казбеги and Скрытые места Тбилиси tours, and a 'НОВИНКА' badge on the newest tour. Position these badges at the top-right corner of the card images.
tasks.testStrategy: Check that the correct badges are displayed on the specified tour cards.

tasks.title: Add 'Book Now' Button to Tour Cards
tasks.description: Include a 'Book Now' button on each tour card.
tasks.details: Add a green 'Book Now' button at the bottom of each tour card, linking to the respective /tour/[slug] page.
tasks.testStrategy: Ensure the 'Book Now' button is present and functional on all tour cards.

tasks.title: Update Tour Section Title
tasks.description: Revise the title and subtitle of the tour section.
tasks.details: Change the section title from 'Наши маршруты' to 'Избранные маршруты' and add a 'Посмотреть все →' link at the top-right of the section.
tasks.testStrategy: Verify the updated title and link are displayed correctly in the tour section.

tasks.title: Redesign 'How it Works' Section
tasks.description: Revamp the process section with a clear layout.
tasks.details: Create a 3-step process section with large numbered icons: Step 1: 'Выбери маршрут', Step 2: 'Оплати онлайн', Step 3: 'Встреча у отеля'. Use a clean horizontal layout for desktop and vertical for mobile. Label the section 'КАК ЭТО РАБОТАЕТ' in small caps green.
tasks.testStrategy: Check the layout and content of the redesigned 'How it Works' section on both desktop and mobile.

tasks.title: Move Testimonials Section Higher
tasks.description: Reposition the testimonials section above the FAQ.
tasks.details: Adjust the page layout to move the testimonials section to a higher position, above the FAQ section.
tasks.testStrategy: Ensure the testimonials section is correctly positioned above the FAQ section.

tasks.title: Enhance Review Cards
tasks.description: Improve the visual appeal of review cards.
tasks.details: Add a country flag emoji next to each reviewer's name, include an avatar (photo or colored initial), and display a star rating (★★★★★) on each card. Update the section title to 'Что говорят путешественники'.
tasks.testStrategy: Verify the enhancements are visible on all review cards.

tasks.title: Add Sticky Booking Panel to Tour Detail Pages
tasks.description: Implement a sticky booking panel for desktop view on tour detail pages.
tasks.details: Create a fixed right panel (380px wide) that appears after scrolling past the hero section. Include tour name, price, duration, group size warning, a full-width 'ЗАБРОНИРОВАТЬ' button, and a 'Написать в WhatsApp' text link. Add urgency text: 'Группа до 6 человек · Ближайшие даты'.
tasks.testStrategy: Test the visibility and functionality of the sticky booking panel on desktop.

tasks.title: Add Photo Gallery to Tour Detail Pages
tasks.description: Replace text-only top with a photo gallery on tour detail pages.
tasks.details: Add a 3-photo gallery at the top of each tour detail page. Display the main photo large on the left and two smaller photos in a right column. Enable click to open a lightbox view.
tasks.testStrategy: Ensure the photo gallery is displayed correctly and the lightbox functionality works.

tasks.title: Add 'Included/Not Included' Checklist
tasks.description: Add a checklist of included and not included items on tour detail pages.
tasks.details: Create a two-column layout with icons for the checklist. Include: ✅ Включено: транспорт, гид, программа; ❌ Не включено: еда, входные билеты, личные расходы.
tasks.testStrategy: Verify the checklist is displayed correctly with appropriate icons.

tasks.title: Add Breadcrumb Navigation to Tour Detail Pages
tasks.description: Introduce breadcrumb navigation for better user orientation.
tasks.details: Add breadcrumb navigation below the header and above the tour content, formatted as 'Главная > Туры > Казбеги за 1 день'.
tasks.testStrategy: Check the presence and functionality of the breadcrumb navigation on tour detail pages.

tasks.title: Add Urgency Element to Tour Detail Pages
tasks.description: Display an urgency message near the booking button.
tasks.details: Add a static urgency message 'Осталось мест на эту неделю: X' near the booking button on tour detail pages.
tasks.testStrategy: Ensure the urgency message is displayed correctly and prominently.

tasks.title: Add Montserrat Font for Headlines
tasks.description: Implement Montserrat font for all headlines.
tasks.details: Import Montserrat 700 and 800 from Google Fonts and apply to h1, h2, h3, and .section-title elements. Retain Raleway/Inter for body text.
tasks.testStrategy: Verify that all headlines use the Montserrat font and body text remains unchanged.

tasks.title: Global Color Replacement
tasks.description: Replace all instances of blue with the new green color globally.
tasks.details: Replace all occurrences of #1A56DB with #2d6a4f in the CSS and HTML files. Ensure :root CSS variables are updated if present.
tasks.testStrategy: Check that all elements previously using blue now use the new green color.

tasks.title: Improve Cookie Banner
tasks.description: Redesign the cookie banner to be less intrusive.
tasks.details: Replace the full-screen modal cookie banner with a thin bottom bar (48px) to reduce intrusiveness, especially on mobile.
tasks.testStrategy: Ensure the new cookie banner is visible and less intrusive on both desktop and mobile.

tasks.title: Fix Tour Card Spacing on Mobile
tasks.description: Adjust tour card spacing for mobile viewports.
tasks.details: Ensure tour cards are full width on mobile with proper 16px horizontal padding, especially on 390px wide screens.
tasks.testStrategy: Verify the spacing and layout of tour cards on mobile devices.

tasks.title: Test All CTAs for Thumb Accessibility
tasks.description: Ensure all call-to-action buttons are easily accessible on mobile.
tasks.details: Review the placement of all CTAs to ensure they are not in the top 20% of the mobile screen and that WhatsApp is always reachable.
tasks.testStrategy: Test the accessibility of all CTAs on mobile devices to ensure they are thumb-accessible.
